questions.question: Three students of class VIII participated in a race during a school sports day. In a 1 km race, A wins the race with B by 100 m, and in a 300 m race, B beats C by 50 m. Then in the race of 1 km, with what margin will A beat C?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A wins the race with B by 100 m in a 1 km (1000 m) race

B beats C by 50 m in a 300 m race

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

**Calculation:**

Let Speed of A = SA

Let Speed of B = SB

Let Speed of C = SC

From the 1 km race:

Time taken by A to cover 1000 m = Time taken by B to cover 900 m

⇒ 1000 / SA = 900 / SB

⇒ SA / SB = 1000 / 900 = 10 / 9

From the 300 m race:

Time taken by B to cover 300 m = Time taken by C to cover 250 m

⇒ 300 / SB = 250 / SC

⇒ SB / SC = 300 / 250 = 6 / 5

Combining both ratios:

SA / SB = 10 / 9

SB / SC = 6 / 5

⇒ SA / SC = (10 / 9) × (6 / 5)

⇒ SA / SC = 4 / 3

In a 1 km (1000 m) race:

Time taken by A to cover 1000 m = Time taken by C to cover (1000 × 3 / 4) m

⇒ C covers 750 m when A covers 1000 m

⇒ A beats C by 1000 - 750 = 250 m

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**

• The period is the time taken for one complete cycle of the wave to pass a given point.
 
• It is usually measured in seconds (s).

• The period is the inverse of the frequency: T = 1/f.
 
• Similarly, frequency is the inverse of the period: f = 1/T.

• The Marathas were led by their commander-in-chief, **Sadashivrao Bhau**, while the Afghan forces were commanded by Ahmad Shah Abdali.

• **Consequences:**

• The battle also paved the way for the eventual rise of British power in India as the Marathas were one of the main obstacles to their expansion.
 
 
 
• **Historical Significance:**

• Baking soda is chemically known as **sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3)**.
 
• The reaction of NaCl, H2O, CO2, and NH3 produces baking soda as one of the products.

• Developed by Ernest Solvay in 1861.
 
• It is an industrial method for the production of sodium carbonate (washing soda).
 
• Involves the reaction of sodium chloride, ammonia, and carbon dioxide in water.
 
• The process is more environmentally friendly compared to the older Leblanc process.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Sodium Bicarbonate:**
 
 
• Used in baking as a leavening agent.
 
• Commonly used as an antacid to treat heartburn and indigestion.
 
• Utilized in fire extinguishers for chemical and electrical fires.
 
• Employed in cleaning products due to its mild abrasive properties.
 
 
 
• **Chemical Properties of Sodium Bicarbonate:**
 
 
• It is a white crystalline solid or a fine powder.
 
• Soluble in water, producing a mildly alkaline solution.
 
• When heated, it decomposes to produce sodium carbonate, water, and carbon dioxide.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Impact:**
 
 
• The Solvay process is less polluting than the Leblanc process, producing fewer byproducts.
 
• Baking soda itself is non-toxic and environmentally benign.

• **Cholera** is an acute diarrheal infection caused by ingestion of food or water contaminated with the bacterium *Vibrio cholerae*.
 
• It can cause severe dehydration and, if untreated, can lead to death within hours.
 
• Cholera outbreaks are often linked to inadequate access to clean water and sanitation facilities.
 
• The disease is most common in places with poor sanitation, crowding, war, and famine.
 
• Cholera can be prevented with proper sanitation, clean drinking water, and oral cholera vaccines.

• **Vibrio cholerae:** The bacterium responsible for cholera, which produces a toxin that causes the rapid loss of fluids and electrolytes.
 
• **Symptoms:** Include severe watery diarrhea, vomiting, and leg cramps. In severe cases, it can lead to shock and death within hours.
 
• **Transmission:** Mainly occurs through the consumption of contaminated water or food. Person-to-person transmission is rare.

questions.question: What is Gross Domestic Product (GDP) in the context of National Income Accounting?

options.text: The total exports of a country
The total savings of a nation
The total value of all goods and services produced within a country's borders in a specific period
The total income of a country's government

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The total value of all goods and services produced within a country's borders in a specific period**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Gross Domestic Product (GDP) represents the total market value of all final goods and services produced within a country during a specific period, usually a year or a quarter.
 
• It is a key indicator used to gauge the health of a country's economy and overall economic activity.
 
• GDP can be measured using three approaches: production (or output) approach, income approach, and expenditure approach.
 
• Real GDP is adjusted for inflation, providing a more accurate reflection of an economy's size and how it is growing over time.
 
• The growth rate of GDP is used to compare the economic performance of different countries or regions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gross National Product (GNP):**

 
 
• GNP measures the total economic output produced by a country's residents, regardless of the location of the production.
 
• It includes GDP plus income earned by residents from overseas investments minus income earned within the domestic economy by foreign residents.
 
 
 
• **Net National Product (NNP):**
 
 
• NNP is derived by subtracting depreciation (the loss of value of capital goods over time) from GNP.
 
• It represents the net value of goods and services produced by a country's residents.
 
 
 
• **Purchasing Power Parity (PPP):**
 
 
• PPP is an economic theory that compares different countries' currencies through a "basket of goods" approach.
 
• It is used to determine the relative value of currencies and to compare the cost of living between different countries.
 
 
 
• **Per Capita GDP:**
 
 
• Per Capita GDP is the average economic output per person, calculated by dividing the GDP by the total population.
 
• It is often used as an indicator of the standard of living and economic well-being of a country's residents.

__
 
• The given sentence is in the superlative degree.
 
• To change it to the positive degree, the structure used is **"No other + noun + is as + positive form of adjective + as + subject"**.
 
• In this case, the sentence structure becomes **"No other planet is as small as Mercury in the Solar System"**.

Correct sentence: *No other planet is as small as Mercury in the Solar System.*

• **Usage: **To compare two entities.
 
 
 
• **Superlative Degree:**
 
 
• **Structure: **Subject + verb + the + superlative adjective + noun.
 
• **Example: **Mercury is the smallest planet in the Solar System.
 
• **Usage: **To show the highest degree of comparison among three or more entities.
